title: Bala ke dasht mein ashoor ko jo shaam huwi
body:
bala ke dasht mein ashoor ko jo shaam huwi
kata hussain ka sar . . .
kata hussain ka sar fauje haq tamam huwi
1. kata ke shano ko shabbir ke baradar ne
wafa ko di hai baqa karbala ke hyder ne
bujhe charaag-e-ali bekaso ki shaam huwi
<<DIVIDER>>
2. dilo ko fatha kiya tune istarha asghar
jo waar tune kiya jis se ro pada lashkar
tere labon ki hasi teg be niyam huwi
<<DIVIDER>>
3. rahi na fauj na sardar na alambardar
phiraya jayega itrat ko ab sar-e-bazaar
ilahi dasht-e-bala yeh kaisi shaam huwi
<<DIVIDER>>
4. tabahi qaimo mein aayi rahi na koi paas
mila hai zainab e muztar ko mansabe abbas
sahara ahle haram ka bani jo shaam huwi
<<DIVIDER>>
5. jale qayaam to zainab ne badke di yeh sada
nahi hai koi muhafiz meri chini hai rida
talaya karti thi zainab jo ban mei shaam huwi
<<DIVIDER>>
6. woh nok-e-naiza se quraan pad rahe hai hussain
yeh shahzadiya ro ro ke kar rahi hai bain
yeh shahre shaam mein kaisi bala ki shaam huwi
<<DIVIDER>>
7. tamam ranjo masayeb ko seh gayi bibi
sar-e-hussain pe sar rakh ke so gayi bibi
main kya bataun ke zindan mein kaisi shaam huwi
<<DIVIDER>>
8. aza-e-shah mein nouhon se milgayi izzat
gham-e-hussain mein masroof y0un huwe sarwat
najaf mein subha huwi karbala mein shaam huwi
